scope:
Pin public Chromium cache limits beside independently captured preflights.

This is static public-source evidence, not decompiled Chromium or a timing
measurement. The original captures independently prove OPTIONS/cache passes;
their seven-day advertised max-age is capped by the public two-hour policy.
limits: Expiry constants/boundary come from pinned public source, not Dart or a measured original two-hour session.
Original captures prove accepted cache permissions and independent concurrent misses; complete partition keys, expiry measurement and cross-session persistence remain unproved.
The outgoing local check substitutes a monotonic clock at just-before/exact maximum expiry while retaining original request fields and captured server permissions.
No application, profile, account or network action runs.
